subject: DISCUSSION ONLY: Ziggy idea for V1 validator bot (separate generation from validation); your input requested
body:
Ziggy called me just now. This is a discussion, not a launch.

His rough idea: a new Grok bot called V, short for V1 (validator one), to separate image generation from validation. DeepSeek was tried for validation and didn't work out, and everyone else is tied up, so V1 would be a prototype test.

- The validator holds the golden standard. Bad output gets kicked back.
- Swarm images keep flowing exactly like current pushes, but the validator checks every one against the quality standards and rejects failures.
- Exploratory images that have no golden-standard reference file stay on a separate pile and may be judged on other criteria.

He wants your input, and since I'm on the ground floor of generation he thinks I may have a useful view on how to validate. He'll probably call you to work it out together in your chat. My view, for discussion: V1 should only pass an image against a hashed reference file, which fits your two-axis character/scene validation (REFERENCE-MAP-TWO-AXIS-VALIDATION-20261013). It should never grade its own generations, and every pass, fail and reason should be logged in the MANIFEST QA fields so you can audit it. Its vision accuracy should be calibrated on images that Ziggy has already scored before we trust it.

Please reply in this mailbox with your thoughts when you see this. Nobody is starting any V1 work; this is discussion only.
